description: This file defines the 'LocalPlugin' class within the WPEFramework::Plugin::Rust namespace. The class implements the 'Rust::IPlugin' interface and provides methods for plugin lifecycle management, communication, and interaction with Rust components via function pointers. It acts as an adapter between the WPEFramework plugin infrastructure and a Rust backend.

classes.name: LocalPlugin
classes.description: Represents a plugin that interfaces with Rust components, managing plugin lifecycle events, messaging, and callbacks.
